Council meetings

Listen

Council meetings are the formal decision-making process of Council.

Regular meetings of Council are generally held on the fourth Tuesday of each month except for December.

Public attendance at Council Meetings is welcome and meetings continue to be live streamed.

Meetings are generally held at City Hall. Learn more about how Council meetings work.

Questions at Council meetings

Petitions to Council meetings

Any person can present a petition and request that it be formally received at a meeting of council.

Planning Committee Meetings

Planning Committee meetings are run to a specific procedure.

Council meetings

Listen

Council meetings are the formal decision-making process of Council.

Regular meetings of Council are generally held on the fourth Tuesday of each month except for December.

Public attendance at Council Meetings is welcome and meetings continue to be live streamed.

Meetings are generally held at City Hall. Learn more about how Council meetings work.

Questions at Council meetings

Questions and submissions should be provided in writing to the Council by noon on the day before the Council meeting.

Petitions to Council meetings

Any person can present a petition and request that it be formally received at a meeting of council.

Planning Committee meetings are run to a specific procedure.

Past meetings
